# Notification Assumptions Note 1

We assume that notification handling of mute interacts with opt-in; teams noted that deliverywindow depends on suppression and push, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that notification handling of digestcadence interacts with digest; teams noted that subscriber depends on deeplink and bounce, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: notification handling of delivery interacts with fanout; teams noted that batching depends on unsubscribe and quiethours, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that notification handling of throttling interacts with channel; teams noted that escalation depends on inbox and template, especially under real production load.
